pages.body:
Tripadvisor
                                            
                                              Tripadvisor, one of the world's largest travel guidance platforms*, helps travelers with travel – from planning to booking to taking a trip. Travelers across the globe use the Tripadvisor site and app to discover where to stay, what to do and where to eat based on guidance from those who have been there before. With more than 1 billion reviews and opinions of nearly 8 million businesses, travelers turn to Tripadvisor to find deals on accommodations, book experiences, reserve tables at delicious restaurants, and discover great places nearby.
                                              
                                              * Source: SimilarWeb, unique users de-duplicated monthly, June 2022
** Source: Tripadvisor internal log files 
                                          
                                        
									

										What does Choice do?
                                      Choice is proud to work with Tripadvisor to reach customers  who are looking  to explore travel  destinations, discover a hotel, and to read customer reviews. The following are some ways that Choice works with Tripadvisor to help drive business to your hotel: 
                                      
                                          National advertising campaigns 
                                          Tripadvisor Business Advantage (TABA) 
                                          
                                            Enhanced listings for individual hotels 
                                          
                                          Regional advertising campaigns  (as part of the Co-op Marketing Program) 
                                        Meta Search and Sponsored Placements 
                                          
                                            To support chiocehotels.com bookings over Online Travel Agencies  (OTAs) 
                                          

                                        
                                        What can I do?
                                      
                                          Review Tripadvisor Business Advantage  Overview
                                          Work with Revenue Management to ensure your hotel is in parity  with Online Travel Agencies  (OTA)
                                          Refer to the Reputation Management Success Toolkit for tips on responding to guest  reviews.
                                          Explore Sojern’s Pay on the Stay program to run your own paid digital media campaigns.                                      
                                        
                                         
                                        Tripadvisor Visual Examples
                                      
                                          
                                            
                                              Business Advantage:
                                              National Ad Sample  Banner Ad:
                                            
                                            
                                              
                                              Desktop View 
                                              
                                            
                                          
                                      
                                       
                                        Tripadvisor Business Advantage Education Webinar
                                        

										 
										Tripadvisor FAQs
                                        This section  highlights some of the key questions that may arise.
                                         
                                        How do I make a change  to my Tripadvisor listing?
                                      
                                          To control  your Tripadvisor listing,  simply log into the Tripadvisor Management Center and  to change photos, update information  and more. 
                                          If you have a question or an issue, please submit a request here and Choice will assist you. 
                                      
                                       
                                        How do I report a major  renovation?
                                        If you have completely refurbished your property and want to update your listing, you can update your TripAdvisor listing by  following these steps:
                                      Visit the owner support page.
                                      
                                          Fill out the form with the required information. 
                                          Attach the relative documentation. Tripadvisor requires official proof that  a top-to-bottom renovation took  place. On this webpage, you’ll see the list of accepted documents in this form. 
                                          Click Submit. 
                                          Upon verifying the documentation provided, Tripadvisor will get in touch  via email within  3- 5 business days. If your property’s renovation meets the criteria,  and substantially changes the traveler’s experience,  Tripadvisor will delete the old reviews and photos that were written prior to the renovation. Please  note that this removal is irreversible and may affect  your ranking. 
                                        
                                       
                                      How do I update  my hotel star rating?
                                        The Hotel Class star ratings are provided to us from  third parties, such as Giata, and national  ratings organizations. These are  found on the hotel's listing  page in the “About” section. More information here
                                        
                                      
                                          Log in to the Management Center
                                            Hover over the Manage  Listing tab 
                                            Click Amenities (Cuisines & Amenities for Restaurants) 
                                            Select the amenities you wish to appear on your listing 
                                            Click Submit 
                                      
                                       
                                          Why  am I unable to delete the Management Photos?
                                          Tripadvisor receives a direct feed of updates  from Choice. Because these photos are provided to us via a direct feed, Tripadvisor is not able to change  them. Click here to add  photos or click here to delete photos.
                                       
                                          How do I report  a review?
                                          To report  a review:
                                      
                                            Log in to the Management Center.
                                            Click the Reviews tab in the top navigation bar. 
                                            Select Report a Review. 
                                            Under What is the problem with the review?  select the most appropriate reason. 
                                            Select the title of the review in question. 
                                            Leave your comment and click Submit. 
                                            TripAdvisor’s moderation team will have a closer  look at the review and will get back to you  via email in the next 3-5 business days. 
                                          
                                          Please note that TripAdvisor only removes reviews  that violate their review guidelines, are suspicious, or are posted in the  wrong location.
                                       
                                          Tripadvisor Business Advantage
                                           I used to have my own Tripadvisor Business Advantage subscription, now Choice funds these,  what do I do?
                                      
                                            Choice funded Business Advantage  prior to the pandemic and has brought  back this marketing tactic  again to enhance your hotel’s visibility on Tripadvisor. 
                                            When your subscription  ends, your hotel will rotate into  the Choice Subscription.
                                            There’s NO upfront cost to you, Choice has it  covered! It’s a pay-for-performance model, meaning Choice is covering the  upfront costs and you simply pay  10% on consumed stays that result from the Business  Advantage enhanced listing.
                                      
                                       
										 
										What is Tripadvisor
                             Tripadvisor,  one of the world's largest travel guidance platforms*, helps people become  better travelers, from planning to booking to taking a trip. Travelers across  the globe use the Tripadvisor site and app to discover where to stay,  what to do and where to eat based on guidance from those who have been there  before. With more than 1 billion reviews and opinions of nearly  8 million businesses, travelers turn to Tripadvisor to find  deals on accommodations, book experiences, reserve tables at delicious  restaurants and discover great places nearby.
                             
                             
                               What  is Tripadvisor? (5 Pages PDF)
                               Tripadvisor  Business Advantage Overview  (2 Pages PDF)
                               I  have a question on Tripadvisor or Tripadvisor Business Advantage
                               
                                 Be  sure to visit the Tripadvisor Management Center
                                 Have  another question? Click here
                               
                               
                             
                             Here are some additional tips from Tripadvisor:
                             
                               New Management Center
                               Telling Your Accommodations' Story Through Photos
                                Special Offers
                               Storyboard: Tell your hotel’s story, your way
                               Bring Your Business to Life with Property Videos
                               Management Center Guide
                               
                             Note: be sure that your hotel's visuals follow your brands visual identity standards.
                                        
                                         * Source:  SimilarWeb, unique users de-duplicated monthly, June 2022 
                               **  Source: Tripadvisor internal log files
pages.bodyHtml:
Tripadvisor

Tripadvisor, one of the world's largest travel guidance platforms*, helps travelers with travel – from planning to booking to taking a trip. Travelers across the globe use the Tripadvisor site and app to discover where to stay, what to do and where to eat based on guidance from those who have been there before. With more than 1 billion reviews and opinions of nearly 8 million businesses, travelers turn to Tripadvisor to find deals on accommodations, book experiences, reserve tables at delicious restaurants, and discover great places nearby.

* Source: SimilarWeb, unique users de-duplicated monthly, June 2022
** Source: Tripadvisor internal log files

What does Choice do?

Choice is proud to work with Tripadvisor to reach customers who are looking to explore travel destinations, discover a hotel, and to read customer reviews. The following are some ways that Choice works with Tripadvisor to help drive business to your hotel:

  • National advertising campaigns
  • Tripadvisor Business Advantage (TABA)
    • Enhanced listings for individual hotels
  • Regional advertising campaigns (as part of the Co-op Marketing Program)
  • Meta Search and Sponsored Placements
    • To support chiocehotels.com bookings over Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)

What can I do?

  • Review Tripadvisor Business Advantage Overview
  • Work with Revenue Management to ensure your hotel is in parity with Online Travel Agencies (OTA)
  • Refer to the Reputation Management Success Toolkit for tips on responding to guest reviews.
  • Explore Sojern’s Pay on the Stay program to run your own paid digital media campaigns.

 

Tripadvisor Visual Examples

Business Advantage:

National Ad Sample Banner Ad:

Desktop View

 

Tripadvisor Business Advantage Education Webinar

 

Tripadvisor FAQs

This section highlights some of the key questions that may arise.

 

How do I make a change to my Tripadvisor listing?

  • To control your Tripadvisor listing, simply log into the Tripadvisor Management Center and to change photos, update information and more.
  • If you have a question or an issue, please submit a request here and Choice will assist you.

 

How do I report a major renovation?

If you have completely refurbished your property and want to update your listing, you can update your TripAdvisor listing by following these steps:

Visit the owner support page.

  • Fill out the form with the required information.
  • Attach the relative documentation. Tripadvisor requires official proof that a top-to-bottom renovation took place. On this webpage, you’ll see the list of accepted documents in this form.
  • Click Submit.
  • Upon verifying the documentation provided, Tripadvisor will get in touch via email within 3- 5 business days. If your property’s renovation meets the criteria, and substantially changes the traveler’s experience, Tripadvisor will delete the old reviews and photos that were written prior to the renovation. Please note that this removal is irreversible and may affect your ranking.

 

How do I update my hotel star rating?

The Hotel Class star ratings are provided to us from third parties, such as Giata, and national ratings organizations. These are found on the hotel's listing page in the “About” section. More information here

  • Log in to the Management Center
  • Hover over the Manage Listing tab
  • Click Amenities (Cuisines & Amenities for Restaurants)
  • Select the amenities you wish to appear on your listing
  • Click Submit

 

Why am I unable to delete the Management Photos?

Tripadvisor receives a direct feed of updates from Choice. Because these photos are provided to us via a direct feed, Tripadvisor is not able to change them. Click here to add photos or click here to delete photos.

 

How do I report a review?

To report a review:

  • Log in to the Management Center.
  • Click the Reviews tab in the top navigation bar.
  • Select Report a Review.
  • Under What is the problem with the review? select the most appropriate reason.
  • Select the title of the review in question.
  • Leave your comment and click Submit.
  • TripAdvisor’s moderation team will have a closer look at the review and will get back to you via email in the next 3-5 business days.

Please note that TripAdvisor only removes reviews that violate their review guidelines, are suspicious, or are posted in the wrong location.

 

Tripadvisor Business Advantage

 I used to have my own Tripadvisor Business Advantage subscription, now Choice funds these, what do I do?

  • Choice funded Business Advantage prior to the pandemic and has brought back this marketing tactic again to enhance your hotel’s visibility on Tripadvisor.
  • When your subscription ends, your hotel will rotate into the Choice Subscription.
  • There’s NO upfront cost to you, Choice has it covered! It’s a pay-for-performance model, meaning Choice is covering the upfront costs and you simply pay 10% on consumed stays that result from the Business Advantage enhanced listing.

 

 

What is Tripadvisor

Tripadvisor, one of the world's largest travel guidance platforms*, helps people become better travelers, from planning to booking to taking a trip. Travelers across the globe use the Tripadvisor site and app to discover where to stay, what to do and where to eat based on guidance from those who have been there before. With more than 1 billion reviews and opinions of nearly 8 million businesses, travelers turn to Tripadvisor to find deals on accommodations, book experiences, reserve tables at delicious restaurants and discover great places nearby.

  • What is Tripadvisor? (5 Pages PDF)
  • Tripadvisor Business Advantage Overview (2 Pages PDF)
  • I have a question on Tripadvisor or Tripadvisor Business Advantage
    • Be sure to visit the Tripadvisor Management Center
    • Have another question? Click here

Here are some additional tips from Tripadvisor:

  • New Management Center
  • Telling Your Accommodations' Story Through Photos
  • Special Offers
  • Storyboard: Tell your hotel’s story, your way
  • Bring Your Business to Life with Property Videos
  • Management Center Guide

Note: be sure that your hotel's visuals follow your brands visual identity standards.

* Source: SimilarWeb, unique users de-duplicated monthly, June 2022
** Source: Tripadvisor internal log files

pages.body:
A website is an important tool  for any company to provide more information to customers, helps ensure credibility  and is key in generating revenue. Every  hotel within Choice has a property page that showcases key information, photos  and provides an easy way for guests to book your hotel. 
                             
                               ChoiceHotels.com  Property Page 
                               
                                 Property  Page Overview
                                 Property  Page Checklist
                                 Property Page FAQs
							     Your  Property Page URL:

Remember to display your marketable URL on all your  hotel materials: guest folios, business cards, rack cards, brochures and so on. pages.title: B2B Marketing
pages.body:
B2B Marketing Opportunities
								  Choice has  over 100 sellers across the U.S., Canada, and CALA, representing all brands to more  than1,600 national and globally managed accounts. Choice also has a specialized  team dedicated to fostering local demand among more than 28,000 small- to  mid-size accounts.
								  While Choice  drives awareness and demand through national sales efforts, hotels play a  critical role in converting opportunities and building relationships within  their local markets. Active participation in meetings, group sales, travel  management company (TMC), and consortia programs helps maximize visibility and  capture valuable business travel and group revenue opportunities.
								  The  following property-level marketing opportunities can help increase visibility  among meeting planners, travel managers, travel advisors, and local business  decision-makers while driving incremental group and transient business.
								   
								  CVENT
								  CVENT is the  leading venue-sourcing platform used by more than 160,000 meeting and event  planners worldwide. Maintaining a strong presence on CVENT helps increase  visibility, generate qualified leads, and position your hotel as a preferred  venue for meetings, events, and group business.                                  
								  CVENT offers  a variety of marketing opportunities, with pricing and availability varying by  market and demand.
								   Marketing  Opportunities:                                  
								  Check with  your CVENT rep for up-to-date pricing and availability.                                  
								  Diamond  Listing (1-4 Diamond Listing Options)
							      With CVENT Diamond Listings,  you can further enhance your venue’s advertising content to highlight key information  up front, secure heightened visibility in the CSN search results, and strengthen  your presence in AI sourcing tools such as Cvent Venue Recommendations (coming  soon). Availability is limited in each market. Check with your CVENT rep for  pricing and availability.                                  
								   Smart Ads
							      Target event planners while  they are actively researching venues across the CVENT network, helping keep  your property top of mind throughout the planning journey.                                  
								   CVENT  Planner Sourcing Report
							      Gain valuable insights into  planner activity, market demand trends, and sourcing behavior to better inform  your sales strategy.                                  
								   Planner  Navigator
						          Identify and engage  planners who are actively sourcing events in your market, allowing your team to  focus outreach efforts on high-potential opportunities. Learn More                                  
								  
								    Claim  Wedding Spot
						          Increase visibility  among couples searching for wedding venues by claiming and optimizing your  Wedding Spot profile. Learn More                                  
								  Audit  Full Listing & Update photos
							      Review your CVENT profile every  3–6 months to ensure photos, amenities, meeting space details, and property  descriptions accurately reflect your hotel and current offerings.
								   
								  Travel Management Companies (TMC) &  Consortia
                                  Why It  Matters:
                                  Travel Management Companies  (TMCs) and consortia networks influence millions of corporate and leisure  travel bookings annually. Through Choice Hotels’ preferred partnerships and  Pay-for-Performance (PFP) programs, participating hotels gain enhanced  visibility with some of the most influential travel advisors and agencies  worldwide.
                                   Market  Reach:
                                  Travel agents primarily use the Global Distribution Systems* (GDS) as their  channel of choice to make real-time reservations for both corporate and leisure  travelers and are doing so in record numbers. GDSs help hotels access nearly  100,000 portals and more than 600,000 travel agents worldwide.**
                                   *Global  Distribution Systems (GDS): Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport (Worldspan, Apollo,  Galileo)
                                                                      Learn more  about TMC & Consortia Market.
                                   Hotel  Responsibility
                                    To maximize opportunities generated through Choice’s TMC and Consortia  partnerships, hotels should maintain accurate GDS content, competitive rate  availability, current amenities, and timely responses to travel advisor  inquiries. Active participation helps improve visibility and conversion within  these channels.
                                   Marketing Opportunities:
                                    TMC Property Level Marketing  Opportunities (1 Page PDF)
                                    Search the National Account List (3 Page PDF)
pages.bodyHtml:
B2B Marketing Opportunities

Choice has over 100 sellers across the U.S., Canada, and CALA, representing all brands to more than1,600 national and globally managed accounts. Choice also has a specialized team dedicated to fostering local demand among more than 28,000 small- to mid-size accounts.

While Choice drives awareness and demand through national sales efforts, hotels play a critical role in converting opportunities and building relationships within their local markets. Active participation in meetings, group sales, travel management company (TMC), and consortia programs helps maximize visibility and capture valuable business travel and group revenue opportunities.

The following property-level marketing opportunities can help increase visibility among meeting planners, travel managers, travel advisors, and local business decision-makers while driving incremental group and transient business.

 

CVENT

CVENT is the leading venue-sourcing platform used by more than 160,000 meeting and event planners worldwide. Maintaining a strong presence on CVENT helps increase visibility, generate qualified leads, and position your hotel as a preferred venue for meetings, events, and group business.

CVENT offers a variety of marketing opportunities, with pricing and availability varying by market and demand.

Marketing Opportunities:

Check with your CVENT rep for up-to-date pricing and availability.

Diamond Listing (1-4 Diamond Listing Options)
With CVENT Diamond Listings, you can further enhance your venue’s advertising content to highlight key information up front, secure heightened visibility in the CSN search results, and strengthen your presence in AI sourcing tools such as Cvent Venue Recommendations (coming soon). Availability is limited in each market. Check with your CVENT rep for pricing and availability.

Smart Ads
Target event planners while they are actively researching venues across the CVENT network, helping keep your property top of mind throughout the planning journey.

CVENT Planner Sourcing Report
Gain valuable insights into planner activity, market demand trends, and sourcing behavior to better inform your sales strategy.

Planner Navigator
Identify and engage planners who are actively sourcing events in your market, allowing your team to focus outreach efforts on high-potential opportunities. Learn More

Claim Wedding Spot
Increase visibility among couples searching for wedding venues by claiming and optimizing your Wedding Spot profile. Learn More

Audit Full Listing & Update photos
Review your CVENT profile every 3–6 months to ensure photos, amenities, meeting space details, and property descriptions accurately reflect your hotel and current offerings.

 

Travel Management Companies (TMC) & Consortia

Why It Matters:
Travel Management Companies (TMCs) and consortia networks influence millions of corporate and leisure travel bookings annually. Through Choice Hotels’ preferred partnerships and Pay-for-Performance (PFP) programs, participating hotels gain enhanced visibility with some of the most influential travel advisors and agencies worldwide.

Market Reach:
Travel agents primarily use the Global Distribution Systems* (GDS) as their channel of choice to make real-time reservations for both corporate and leisure travelers and are doing so in record numbers. GDSs help hotels access nearly 100,000 portals and more than 600,000 travel agents worldwide.**

*Global Distribution Systems (GDS): Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport (Worldspan, Apollo, Galileo)

Learn more about TMC & Consortia Market.

Hotel Responsibility
To maximize opportunities generated through Choice’s TMC and Consortia partnerships, hotels should maintain accurate GDS content, competitive rate availability, current amenities, and timely responses to travel advisor inquiries. Active participation helps improve visibility and conversion within these channels.

Marketing Opportunities:
TMC Property Level Marketing Opportunities (1 Page PDF)
Search the National Account List (3 Page PDF)
